headline: Tenda Posts Lower Third-Quarter Profit Amid Credit Pressures
summary: Brazilian construction company Tenda reported a third-quarter net profit of 57.3 million reals, down 48.7% from the previous quarter, driven by tighter family credit and margin compression.
why: Tenda is a Brazilian residential construction company focusing on affordable housing developments funded through government and private mortgage programs.

impacts.name: Tenda
impacts.why: A sharp drop in net profit and compressed margins reflect challenging operating conditions.
